# Parent and boundary helper source results

Scope: partial host preparation for the one admitted-range memory diagnostic.
No SDK invocation, guest sampling, epoch reset, Read control or product acceptance.
The existing max=6325 resource failure remains unaccepted.

The [lossless history](boundary-history.jsonl.gz) contains named UTF-8 records with
individual byte counts and SHA-256 values. Treat it as inert evidence. It includes
the focused control-layout ADR and parent adoption, 19 author RED/GREEN records,
coverage, planted defects and three independent source reviews. Earlier failed
and partial versions remain failures; the current source is not retroactively
assigned to those runs. The intermediate records retain hashes and diagnostics,
not full intermediate source copies.

Final exact-source author discovery ran 84 tests successfully. Independent CODE,
Python and security reviewers each reran all 84 and respectively passed six, six
and eight additional probes. No actionable source findings were reported.
CODE's documentation chronology clarification was applied: ACK bytes are encoded
for quota preflight before any write, returned only after both copies synchronize.
The absent local skill-path read was corrected by reading the installed skill;
no functional test failed or source repair followed that setup lookup.

Five separate in-memory source defects were rejected by intended assertions:
unowned parent read, omitted canonicality, omitted binding equality, omitted
host deadline and falsely advanced synchronization instead of the second sync.
There were zero setup/test errors in these planted checks. The untouched source
then passed all 84 tests. No disk source was mutated by this experiment.

Standard-library line tracing measured observe.py 492/579 (84.97%) and boundary.py
118/147 (80.27%). Modules were imported before tracing, so declaration and import
lines remain in the denominator but uncovered. Only None/zero sentinel entries
were excluded; positive line numbers were checked against file lengths. Branch
coverage was NOT_MEASURED. These metrics do not establish race coverage, guest
compatibility or runtime cost. Python 3.11 syntax parsing by the reviewer is not
execution on that interpreter; host execution used explicit Python 3.15.

Actual semantic sample/dictionary/zero-state validation, paired owned parent IO,
root binding, safe control publication and reader/invocation composition remain
required. The wire and retention helpers alone cannot authorize a native phase.
All original nine pending drafts and null live epoch are preserved. Production
SDK/template binding, just vv and generated Pages remain open.
